title.en: Tale 1 — The Donkey and the Neighbour

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: إجا جاره وقال له: بدي الحمار اليوم.
sentences.en: His neighbour came and said: I want the donkey today.
Juha didn't want to give it to him.

sentences.ar: قال له: الحمار مش هون، راح عالسوق.
sentences.en: He said: the donkey is not here, it went to the market.

sentences.ar: بهاي اللحظة، الحمار نهق من ورا البيت.
sentences.en: At that moment, the donkey brayed from behind the house.

sentences.ar: قال الجار: بس أنا بسمع الحمار!
sentences.en: The neighbour said: but I hear the donkey!

sentences.ar: قال جحا: يا زلمة، بتصدق الحمار ولا بتصدقني؟
sentences.en: Juha said: man, do you believe the donkey or do you believe me?
